entities.name: Gaspar de Zúñiga, 5th Count of Monterrey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gaspar de Zúñiga Acevedo y Fonseca, 5th Count of Monterrey was a Spanish nobleman who was the ninth viceroy of New Spain. He governed from November 5, 1595, to October 26, 1603. From January 18, 1604, until his death in 1606, he was viceroy of Peru.
